description: This file is a shell script used for testing the output of 'git push --porcelain' commands, including setup of repositories, creating commits, and verifying push outputs under various conditions.

methods.name: create_commits_in
methods.description: Creates commits in a specified repository and assigns their OIDs to shell variables.

methods.name: get_abbrev_oid
methods.description: Returns an abbreviated OID from a full OID.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Formats git command outputs to be user-friendly and stable for testing.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Processes output to save as expected output for comparison.

methods.name: create_upstream_template
methods.description: Initializes a bare upstream repository with commits and branches.

methods.name: setup_upstream
methods.description: Sets up a mirror upstream repository, optionally over HTTP.

methods.name: setup_upstream_and_workbench
methods.description: Sets up upstream and working repositories for testing, including branch references and configurations.

methods.name: run_git_push_porcelain_output_test
methods.description: Runs tests for 'git push --porcelain' with various scenarios and verifies output formatting and ref states.

methods.name: run_git_push_dry_run_porcelain_output_test
methods.description: Runs dry-run tests for 'git push --porcelain' with various scenarios and verifies output formatting and ref states.
